mustFix.title: The candidate authors forty platform copies while four current-standing clauses deny or forbid that same authorship.
mustFix.detail: whatIsAuthored, authoredCatalog, summary.platformCopiesAuthored, summary.authoredFiles, and the forty platformCopies records say g20-fixture-corpus.v6 authors the per-platform copies now. Disk independently confirms exactly forty declared copies under fixtures/g20.v6, each byte-equal to its fixtures/g20.v2 payload. In direct conflict, doesNot[15] says `Does not author per-platform copies.`; failsIf[25] says the artifact fails if per-platform copies are claimed authored by g20-fixture-corpus.v6; proposedLaterWork[2] says v6 keeps the 8x4 surface-copy layer for a later successor; and proposedLaterWork[3] says a later first-authoring successor may add the copies and v6 does not author them.
mustFix.whyItMatters: The contradiction is on the candidate's sole new purpose, not on incidental history. The affirmative authorship claim literally triggers the candidate's own failsIf condition, while the negative and later-work clauses make the recording effect indeterminate. A D-000 recording cannot safely pin these bytes as the forty-copy authoring successor while those clauses remain.
mustFix.repairShape: Remove or rewrite the four inherited no-copy/later-copy clauses so they agree that g20-fixture-corpus.v6 authors the forty existing platform-indexed copies. Preserve the four quoted occupancy-v2 platforms, the forty byte-equal copies, fixtures/g20.v2 custody, binds NOTHING, and the unchanged leftover-design standing.

shouldFix.title: Current-standing successor routing retains unqualified or historical leftover-join.v6 language after g20 leftover-join.v9 became current.
shouldFix.detail: The candidate correctly states elsewhere that g20 leftover-join.v6 is historical and g20 leftover-join.v9 (D-323) is the current G20 GATE remasurement. proposedLaterWork[1] nevertheless routes the later G20 remasurement `on leftover-join.v6`; remeasurementClause explicitly names leftover-join.v6 while omitting current g20 leftover-join.v9 and the frozen immediate corpus predecessor v5 from its enumerated unmoved set. parentReview.role and doesNot[9] also retain bare leftover-join.v6 wording that collides with the subject's own version integer and does not identify a lineage.
shouldFix.whyItMatters: A later remasurement must succeed the current G20 join, not the frozen D-269 historical join. The intended route is recoverable because basedOn.leftoverJoinV9, authorityClaim, remainderAfterThisCorpus, and recordedInputs correctly pin v9, so this is graded as successor-routing and attribution wording rather than a second MUST-FIX authority defect.
shouldFix.repairShape: Route later G20 remasurement from g20-leftover-join.v9, qualify historical references as g20-leftover-join.v6 where history is intended, keep sdk-leftover-join.v6 distinct, and include the current v9 join and frozen v5 corpus predecessor in the explicit remeasurement custody set.
